variants.label: 12-night canonical plan
variants.notes: The checked-in itinerary remains the immutable comparison baseline: Bled 4 nights + Bovec/Soča 3 (via the Vršič Pass) + Piran 3 (via the Škocjan Caves) + Ljubljana 2, round-trip Ljubljana, one rental car.

sourceLocators.internal-itinerary: Slovenia + Adriatic; variant canonical; route-specific savings/tradeoffs require re-price

alternateNotes: Two alternatives are worth documenting but are not yet cost-reconciled. (1) A warm-swim swap: trim the Piran coast leg and fly a short LCC hop from LJU to a Greek island for a genuinely warm-water week — this raises the swim axis but adds a flight, cost, and a second country, so it needs its own reconciliation. (2) A cheaper gateway: fly PIT->Venice and drive ~2h in, typically $200-400/person under the two-stop LJU fare, at the cost of a cross-border car surcharge. Croatia would be the obvious warm partner but is excluded by family decision.
